explanation: The smooth Poincaré conjecture holds in dimensions 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 12, 56, 61. This agrees with the literature: Wang–Xu settle the odd dimensions (only 1, 3, 5, 61), and Behrens–Hill–Hopkins–Mahowald plus Wang–Xu settle the even dimensions below 140 (2, 6, 12, 56). Low dimensions are classical. Since the h-cobordism theorem identifies homotopy spheres with smooth structures on Sⁿ for n ≥ 5, the formalization is faithful.
